---
title: Demandes de paiement
description: Envoyez des demandes de paiement aux clients avec une date d’expiration.
---

import { Tabs, Tab } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';

L’API Payment requests permet de créer des demandes de paiement limitées dans le temps. Utile pour la facturation et le B2B.

## Créer une demande de paiement

**Référence API (schéma complet) :** [Créer une demande de paiement](/api/payment-requests/PaymentRequestsController_create)

**L’essentiel :** `amount`, `currency_code` et `expiry_date` (ISO 8601) sont obligatoires. Passez optionnellement `customer_id`, `payment_reference`, `description` et `metadata`. La réponse inclut un `payment_url` pour le client.

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "Python", "cURL"]}>

<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
import { LomiSDK } from '@lomi./sdk';

const lomi = new LomiSDK({
  apiKey: process.env.LOMI_SECRET_KEY!,
  environment: 'live',
});

const request = await lomi.paymentRequests.create({
  amount: 50000,
  currency_code: 'XOF',
  expiry_date: '2024-02-15T23:59:59Z',
  description: 'Facture n° INV-2024-001',
  customer_id: 'cus_abc123...',
  payment_reference: 'INV-2024-001',
  metadata: {
    invoice_id: 'INV-2024-001',
  },
});

console.log(`Payment request created: ${request.id}`);
console.log(`Payment URL: ${request.payment_url}`);
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="Python">
```python
from lomi import LomiClient
import os

client = LomiClient(
    api_key=os.environ["LOMI_SECRET_KEY"],
    environment="test"
)

request = client.payment_requests.create({
    "amount": 50000,
    "currency_code": "XOF",
    "expiry_date": "2024-02-15T23:59:59Z",
    "description": "Facture n° INV-2024-001",
    "customer_id": "cus_abc123...",
    "payment_reference": "INV-2024-001"
})

print(f"Payment request: {request['id']}")
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="cURL">
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.lomi.africa/payment-requests" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 50000,
    "currency_code": "XOF",
    "expiry_date": "2024-02-15T23:59:59Z",
    "description": "Facture n° INV-2024-001",
    "customer_id": "cus_abc123...",
    "payment_reference": "INV-2024-001"
  }'
```
</Tab>

</Tabs>

## Lister les demandes de paiement

**Référence API :** [Lister les demandes](/api/payment-requests/PaymentRequestsController_findAll), filtrez par `status`, `customerId`, `limit` et `offset`.

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "Python", "cURL"]}>

<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
const requests = await lomi.paymentRequests.list({
  status: 'pending',
  limit: 20,
});
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="Python">
```python
requests = client.payment_requests.list(status="pending", limit=20)
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="cURL">
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.lomi.africa/payment-requests?status=pending&limit=20" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY"
```
</Tab>

</Tabs>

---

## Obtenir une demande de paiement

**Référence API :** [Obtenir une demande](/api/payment-requests/PaymentRequestsController_findOne)

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "Python", "cURL"]}>

<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
const request = await lomi.paymentRequests.get('pr_abc123...');
console.log(`Status: ${request.status}`);
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="Python">
```python
request = client.payment_requests.get('pr_abc123...')
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="cURL">
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.lomi.africa/payment-requests/pr_abc123..." \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY"
```
</Tab>

</Tabs>

## Webhooks

| Événement | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `payment_request.completed` | Paiement reçu |
| `payment_request.expired` | Demande expirée sans paiement |
